title: 第1574章 周某第1573章 欢欢药阁
lines: 莫千言亲自掌控飞舟，在天际之中，飞速的穿行。
而随着冯百川的飞舟追上来之后，越来越多的飞舟，发现了叶欢飞舟的踪迹，在天际之中，凭借叶欢飞舟飞行留下的波动，四处围堵叶欢他们。
“我靠，这么多的飞舟！”
莫千言大叫着，脸色又汗水流出，全力掌控飞舟，不仅会消耗灵石，对于掌控者也有很大的消耗。
“叶欢，再这么下去，我们支撑不了多久的，就会被他们彻底堵住的！”
可惜。
叶欢现在没空搭理莫千言。
他盘坐在飞舟甲板之上，双眸阖上，浑身蕴含了巨大的能量，犹如一个即将暴涨的核武一般，恐怖，骇人。
忽然。
叶欢开口说道：“哎，要是西方大陆有一个周某就好了，就不会有这么多的飞舟了。”
“周某？什么周某？”
莫千言一愣，左清寒也是不明所以。
叶欢像是平静了不少，他微微一笑，然后摇头，没有给莫千言解释。
在宇宙万域的时候。
有一位大名鼎鼎的大盗，号称周某，实力不算是高深恐怖，但是一身诡异的身法和逃命手段确实通天彻地。
他穿梭虚空，游走在各大家族圣地之中，盗取宝物。
不过他对于什么攻伐圣器，杀器都不是很感兴趣，唯独钟爱飞行法器。
尤其是小型飞行法器，他更是尤为喜欢。
不少福地洞天，圣地圣山，都被周某闯过，甚至一些顶级势力的虚空之舰，也被周某盗取。
他的名声，可以说是在宇宙万域臭名昭著，即便是一心杀伐的叶欢，也是听说过他的名头。
所以，在这西方大陆上，若是有一位周某在，这云霄城的飞舟，早就被盗取了，哪里还能够围剿叶欢。
可惜。
莫千言他们，自然无法领会叶欢的意思。
这时，见到叶欢平静了不少，左清寒终于是走了上来，她身材高挑，一头干净利落的短发，显得英气十足。
不过她却收起了自己的英武之气，反而是有些紧张的咬牙对叶欢说道：“叶欢，对不起，其实我刚才没有那个意思，我也不是一定要你加入人星门，一定要你振兴人族。我只是……担心你，因为你我都是人族。”
叶欢随意瞥了一眼左清寒。
终于平淡地开口道：“你不用和我道歉，我没有怪你，也不会因为你的道歉，而对人族有什么好感，而去为人族做些什么。”
左清寒哑然。
她是一个干净利落，也是一个将种族大义看得极重的女子。
她想要振兴人族，让人族重新成为大陆的顶级种族，可惜太难了，这条路，以她的天赋，无法通行。
但人族曾经出现过希望。
轩辕城。
那是一个惊才艳艳的男子，比起现在的叶欢，更加惊艳。
各族天骄人杰，无上天才，都曾经和轩辕城一战，他二十岁的时候，便能够鏖战人族各大天才了。
二十五的时候，便大显神威，傲视群雄，可以对战各族的天骄了。
content_en:
Mo Qianyan personally controlled the flying boat and traveled rapidly through the sky.
As Feng Baichuan's flying boat caught up, more and more flying boats discovered the traces of Ye Huan's flying boat. In the sky, relying on the fluctuations left by Ye Huan's flying boat's flight, they surrounded Ye Huan and the others.
"Damn, there are so many flying boats!"
Mo Qianyan shouted, sweat dripping from his face. Controlling the flying boat with all his strength would not only consume spiritual stones, but also consume a lot of the controller.
"Ye Huan, if we continue like this, we won't be able to hold on for long, and we will be completely blocked by them!"
What a pity.
Ye Huan has no time to talk to Mo Qianyan now.
He sat cross-legged on the deck of the flying boat, his eyes closed, and his whole body contained huge energy, like a nuclear weapon that was about to explode, terrifying and frightening.
suddenly.
Ye Huan said: "Hey, if only there was a Zhou in the Western Continent, there wouldn't be so many flying boats."
"Zhou? What Zhou?"
Mo Qianyan was stunned, and Zuo Qinghan was also confused.
Ye Huan seemed to have calmed down a lot. He smiled slightly and then shook his head without giving any explanation to Mo Qianyan.
At a time when the universe is vast.
There is a famous thief named Zhou. His strength is not advanced and terrifying, but his strange body skills and escape methods are truly outstanding.
He traveled through the void, wandering around the holy places of major families, stealing treasures.
However, he is not very interested in attacking holy weapons or killing weapons. He only loves flying magical weapons.
He particularly likes small flying instruments.
Many blessed places, caves, and holy mountains were penetrated by Zhou, and even the void ships of some top forces were stolen by Zhou.
His reputation can be said to be notorious throughout the universe. Even Ye Huan, who is bent on killing, has heard of his name.
Therefore, if there was a Zhou in this western continent, the flying boat in Yunxiao City would have been stolen long ago, and there would be no way to surround and suppress Ye Huan.
pity.
Mo Qianyan and the others naturally couldn't understand what Ye Huan meant.
At this time, seeing that Ye Huan had calmed down a lot, Zuo Qinghan finally walked up. She was tall, with neat short hair, and looked very heroic.
However, she put away her heroic spirit, and gritted her teeth nervously and said to Ye Huan: "Ye Huan, I'm sorry, actually I didn't mean that just now. I don't necessarily want you to join the Human Star Sect, but I want you to revitalize the human race. I'm just... worried about you, because you and I are both human race."
Ye Huan casually glanced at Zuo Qinghan.
Finally, he said calmly: "You don't have to apologize to me. I don't blame you, and I won't do anything for the human race because of your apology."
Zuo Qinghan was speechless.
She is a clean-cut woman who takes racial justice very seriously.
She wanted to revitalize the human race and make it the top race on the continent again, but unfortunately it was too difficult. This road was impassable with her talent.
But there was hope for the human race.
Xuanyuan City.
That was a man with stunning talent and beauty, even more stunning than the current Ye Huan.
Prodigies and supreme geniuses from all races have all fought against Xuanyuan City. When he was twenty years old, he was able to fight against all the great geniuses of the human race.
At the age of twenty-five, he will show his great power, stand out from the crowd, and be able to fight against the geniuses of all races.
